reviews.title: Consistently Freezes

reviews.title: Worked great until it didn’t
reviews.text: I’m disappointed to write this because I’ve actually enjoyed using Splice for the past 5 years. There have been bugs along the way but they were always quick to fix whatever was going wrong until this latest bug, which has caused me to cancel my subscription. After spending several hours on a time-sensitive project, I experienced an error message that made the project crash and then become inaccessible. I contacted customer support and did everything the AI assistant suggested but nothing worked. I then deleted the app and reinstalled to start fresh and everything seemed to be OK until I closed the new project and tried to open it again only to see the same error message. I sent multiple messages asking for a real person to look into the error but have not received any acknowledgement of my issues or even a message saying someone was looking into it. It’s too bad they can’t figure out how to keep this app stable because when it works, it’s great. But it’s too expensive to be this unreliable, especially if you depend on it as part of your business, like I do. My advice is to save your money and spare yourself the frustration and try one of the other much less expensive video editing apps. It’s sucks that I’m having to learn a different program and workflow but so far the new app I’m using isn’t crashing and I’m using the same clips and graphics that Splice has suddenly decided it can no longer handle.
